checks.name: Cap rate chip: the asset page shows a Good / Okay / Low chip with its word (never colour alone) next to the cap rate for a home, multi-family, commercial and business asset, the word matches E.capVerdict for that asset type, and at 320, 390, 820 and 1180 (light and dark) nothing is clipped, low contrast or past the edge
checks.repro: asset pages of every kind and several cap rates; read the chip, compare with E.capVerdict, run the sweep
